thread:
emily: Quick design check 1: diff-filter chips order and mass-approve shortcut in prompt-sets UI. Mock: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE-diffchips. Need product + a11y eyes.

ryan: Main issue: filter chips are currently alphabetical; users expect 'regressions' to be first. Suggest move 'Regressions' then 'Changed', 'Unchanged', 'Ignored'.

jules: Agreed. Also when filters change, keyboard focus currently drops to top. We should keep the list focus so screen reader users don't lose context.

priya: Mass-approve shortcut idea: Ctrl+Shift+A to approve selected diffs. Need to ensure desktop only and show tooltip on hover. Also require a confirmation modal if any selected diffs contain a regression.

emily: For the confirmation modal copy: header "Confirm approve X items" subline "Includes Y regressions; approve only if you're sure." Button labels: 'Approve X' and 'Cancel'. Keep consistent with other modals.

uxbot: Automated guidance: If modal opens, set role='dialog', aria-modal='true', and move focus to the modal title. For regression count include aria-live update when selection changes. Contrast: ensure the regression pill meets 3:1 with white text.

jules: Keyboard nuance: after closing the modal with Escape, restore focus to the last selected diff. Also tab order inside modal must loop. I'll add unit tests for focus restore.

ryan: UX nit: chip hover state currently only changes background; add an outline for keyboard focus. Designers: please avoid removing native focus.

priya: For mobile, the shortcut is irrelevant; add an 'Approve' affordance in the toolbar. Also show a compact summary when more than 5 selected: "5+ selected" with a link to view details.

emily: Decision: reorder chips with 'Regressions' first; keep focus in list on filter change; implement Ctrl+Shift+A on desktop with modal confirmation if regressions present; restore focus after modal close; add visible focus styles on chips; mobile toolbar approve and compact count. Action items: ryan update keyboard handlers + shortcut; jules test focus restore; priya update mobile toolbar mocks; design to update Figma.

priya: I'll update Figma tonight and add notes about mobile count behavior.

emily: Thanks all 1: we'll re-run a11ybot after PRs. Schedule quick review tomorrow 11:30am PT. :white_check_mark:
